mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies at Harriet Park are clear with a current temperature of 68 degrees, a waning crescent moon overhead, an overnight low of 64 degrees, and no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona remains committed to infrastructure maintenance, contracting with AECOM Incorporated for ongoing engineering services that are detailed in reports submitted to the City Council throughout the year.
We have a busy couple of days ahead, with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow.
During the early hours of July 28, Verona police conducted a check at Fireman's Park and discovered an occupied vehicle after hours, resulting in an arrest due to an outstanding warrant.

Treat yourself to today's delicious Devil's Food Cake flavor. The shop is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow, when the featured flavor changes to Really Reese's.
